# OzzyRockerPL — scoring system

- Original source: [OzzyRockerPL — scoring system](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2829972690)
- Author / publication: OzzyRockerPL / Steam Community
- Language / date: English; published and updated 2022-07-09
- Access: Page text inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Reported mission-end points:

| Event | Points |
| --- | ---: |
| Main mission completed | 1,000 |
| Ambush shield obtained | 1,000 |
| Ground/coffer money, per £100 | 10 |
| Soldier killed | 50 |
| Soldier still unconscious or bound at completion | 70 |
| Royal collectible | 1,000 |
| Guy or the Sheriff defeated | 100 |

The author reports no points for elapsed time, looted personal money, pre-existing corpses, recovered prisoners, netted/trapped enemies, or the Silver Arrow. Allied kills count.

Includes seventeen mission discussions, conditional Free Lincoln, and a score table. It warns about two swordsmen breaking The Letter's conversation. Pre-existing corpses reportedly affect spared lives despite awarding no points.

**Limitations:** community findings; maxima, rounding, and event classification are unverified.
